name: Valuation Workflow
description: Child workflow compiled from Workbench container Valuation_Workflow.

prompt_policy.user_prompt: Convert model_input_pack and fundamentals into an operating forecast with explicit drivers, base/bull/bear assumptions, and metric_id/source_id support. Block unsupported forecast lines.
Run comparable valuation using verified peer multiples and target operating metrics. Explain peer selection and adjustments; block if peer price/multiple evidence is missing.
Build DCF/SOTP valuation from operating forecast, cash/debt, shares, FX, and segment assumptions. Every price target input must cite metric_id/source_id or be marked blocked.
Create scenario and sensitivity tables for key assumptions, downside/upside drivers, and invalidation thresholds. Identify unsupported prices when inputs are insufficient.

Synthesize valuation into valuation_model, fair_value_range, and price_guidance. If live price, shares, FX, net cash/debt, peer multiples, or cash-flow inputs are missing, set price_guidance.status to blocked/insufficient and list blocking gaps.
